# Kondo--Shimada Fermat quartic data

`compdataAutFQChar3.txt` was downloaded on 2026-08-06 from Ichiro
Shimada's official computational-data page:

<https://www.math.sci.hiroshima-u.ac.jp/shimada/preprints/FermatQuartChar3/autFQ/compdataAutFQChar3.txt>

It accompanies Shigeyuki Kondo and Ichiro Shimada, *The automorphism group
of a supersingular K3 surface with Artin invariant 1 in characteristic 3*,
arXiv:1205.6520v2:

<https://arxiv.org/abs/1205.6520>

The file has 12,763 lines and 1,085,899 bytes.  The Frobenius fold screen
uses only the exact assignments `FQGramS`, `FQh0`, `FQAF`, `FQWW112`,
`FQWW648`, and `FQWW5184`.  The `FQWW*` rows are wall covectors, so their
scalar products are computed with `FQGramS^-1`.
